rationale: Price has bounced sharply off the session low of $14.24, recovering from the maximum favorable excursion back to $14.39 — nearly at entry — with five consecutive 1-minute candles showing higher lows and higher highs, indicating short-term momentum has reversed. The 9-EMA on 5-minute bars is now at $14.43, just above current price, and the take-profit at $14.18 appears increasingly unlikely to be reached without a fresh catalyst. With the position nearly flat and upward pressure building, closing preserves the small gain and avoids the risk of the invalidation at $14.58 being triggered.
